从此站点已有文章的分类中选择: Choose from categories used by existing articles on this site
先冻结当前分叉与工作区；确认后临时封存未提交改动、对已审阅远端提交变基，再恢复改: First freeze the current divergence and worktree. After confirmation, temporarily stash uncommitted changes, rebase onto the reviewed remote commits, and then restore the changes.
原始 Front Matter 会显示在下方编辑器中；可随时切回属性视图。: The raw Front Matter appears in the editor below. You can switch back to the properties view at any time.
打开菜单并添加一个已有分类: Open the menu and add an existing category
显示 Front Matter 的原始文本: Show the raw Front Matter text
本地只领先远端，无需先拉取或变基。: Local is only ahead of the remote; no pull or rebase is needed first.
编辑标题、标签、分类、日期和 slug，或切换到原始 Front Matter: Edit the title, tags, categories, date, and slug, or switch to the raw Front Matter source
输入后按回车添加: Type a value and press Return to add it
输入用于文章 URL 的 slug: Enter the slug used in the article URL
当前工作区干净；将直接变基本地提交。: The worktree is clean; local commits will be rebased directly.
用已审阅的远端提交重放本地提交，并在前后安全封存、恢复未提交改动。: Replay local commits onto the reviewed remote commits, safely stashing and restoring uncommitted changes.
确认前不会改变 HEAD、索引、工作区或 stash。执行前会重新核对分支、远端: Before confirmation, HEAD, the index, worktree, and stash will not change. The branch, remote SHA, differences, and untracked file contents are checked again before running.
重新验证审阅内容后，封存本地改动、变基并恢复改动: Revalidate the review, then stash local changes, rebase, and restore them
